Full means the provider-exposed generated text documented by that model, not independently proven internal computation or faithfulness.
Some raw provider usage reports zero reasoning tokens while returning full text; the text remains captured and usable, and no hidden token count is invented.
Provider names and endpoint versions are returned and checked; quantization suffixes remain outbound selectors rather than independently echoed metadata.
Existing frozen rounds, 63 registry entries and baseline/default selections are preserved.
